nitric oxide and the arachidonic metabolite prostaglandin E2 are produced in striatal neurons in response to activation of N‐methyl‐D‐aspartate (NMDA) receptors.
nitric oxide production is mediated via L‐type Ca2+ channels, whereas arachidonic release is mediated via NMDA receptor‐operated Ca2+ channels.
